hypothesis: A comparison harness with an analytic tolerance policy separates legitimate reduction-order and precision differences from faults: once the fault-free candidate is within the policy, every fault larger than twice the tolerance is detected, detection switches at about the tolerance, and faults up to about the bound escape as often as the fault-size distribution predicts. Exercised CPU-against-CPU: the task has no GPU kernel path.
input_data: orders: sequential, pairwise tree, 32-lane blocked (sequential lanes then tree); precisions float64 and float32
exact dot products by TwoProduct + math.fsum
all 131072 single dropped products per policy, judged by compare_outputs
mathematical_model: For a sum of terms each passing through k roundings, |computed - exact| <= gamma_k * sum|a_j x_j| with gamma_k = k u/(1 - k u), u = 2^-53 (float64) or 2^-24 (float32, inputs rounded). The policy tolerance for two outputs is the sum of their bounds, so the fault-free candidate satisfies |c - r| <= tol; bitwise mode compares bit patterns. A dropped term p gives |c - p - r| >= |p| - tol, so |p| > 2 tol is detected without knowing c - r; with m = max |c - r|/tol, detection switches inside (1 +/- m) tol. With a_ij uniform on [-1, 1), P(|a_ij x_j| <= tol_i) = min(1, tol_i/|x_j|), whose sum over faults predicts the miss count.
numerical_result: 123/128 rows flagged by the bitwise policy between float64 orders (0 for a copy of the reference); max difference/bound 0.00173; float32 violates the float64 policy on 128 rows and stays at 0.00874 of its own bound; faults above twice the tolerance left undetected: 0/131072 (float64 policy), 0/129813 (float32 policy); single dropped products undetected: 0/131072 (float64), 708/131072 (float32, predicted 665.3 +/- 22.5; largest missed |a_j x_j| 0.000589 against row tolerance 0.000594; 1 missed above the row bound, ratio 1.00016). GPU present: False (the task has no GPU kernel path).
observation_model: Elementwise absolute differences, bitwise equality and ratios to the policy bound, as reported by compare_outputs for the fault-free candidates and for every faulty candidate.

uncertainty: Bounds are worst-case (not probabilistic), so typical ratios are far below one; the twice-tolerance guarantee needs only the policy's own premise (fault-free candidate within tolerance), while faults up to about the bound escape at the rate the fault-size distribution predicts (4-sigma check); the harness has not seen GPU fused multiply-add or atomics ordering.

GPU reductions may use FMA and tree shapes not modelled by the 32-lane order
Only single dropped products were injected; other fault classes (duplicated terms, wrong operands) have their own detection limits
No GPU hardware or driver was exercised
